requirements.evidence: Routes entity.queues/entity.serve added (routes/web.php:59-60); Queues contract complete with all properties/methods (app/Livewire/Entity/Queues.php:24-277), scoped findOrFail everywhere (e.g. :100, :128, :225-226), rename re-derives slug via Str::slug (:157), confirmation modal instead of wire:confirm (queues.blade.php:122-143), accessQueue/accessGrants empty on foreign id (:252-261). Serve: defaults to first callable queue (Serve.php:51), waiting list ordered priority desc/issued_at/id limit 30 filtered by mode (:160-176), exceptions mapped to notices, rate limit 10/min on successful calls (:77-98). Members tabs with role="tablist" and setActiveTab whitelist (Members.php:68-75, members.blade.php:7-20). Both locales have all contract keys. Deviation: callNext uses CallMode::tryFrom($this->mode) ?? CallMode::Any (Serve.php:84) instead of CallMode::from, silently turning an invalid mode into 'any'.

conventions.evidence: No tests shipped for Queues or Serve despite 'No production code without a test'; Livewire public input properties name, renameName (Queues.php:27,48), mode (Serve.php:33) and activeTab (Members.php:37) have no #[Validate]; helper methods callableQueues()/selectedQueue() are public (Serve.php:108,124) contrary to rule 5; no CHANGELOG/docs updates in the diff. Positives: domain writes go through CreateQueue/UpdateQueue/SetQueueAccess/CallNextTicket, policies via $this->authorize, Bulma markup matches members page.

security.evidence: All client ids resolved via $this->entity->queues()/memberships()->findOrFail (Queues.php:100,128,150,175,198,212,236-237; Serve.php:73); every write method authorizes (update/manageAccess/create) and actions authorize again; lastCalledTicketId and entity are #[Locked]; output uses {{ }}. Gaps of limited impact: mode, name, renameName, activeTab not validated by the component; public selectedQueue() exposes any same-entity queue to callers without a 'call' check; AuthorizationException left uncaught as required.

tests.evidence: Only existing tests were edited (tests/Feature/Entity/EntityInviteTest.php:179-186, MembersTest.php:377,397-398,414-416) to follow the tab split; no tests for Queues, Serve, routes, navbar, setActiveTab rejection, unauthorized calls or tamper attempts. pt_BR test still asserts assertDontSee('Invite member') which is now trivially true, and invite-label assertions were dropped from the en page test.

simplicity.evidence: Lean components reusing domain actions and existing <x-label>/<x-input>; addDomainErrors helper avoids repetition. Minor redundancy: render passes duplicate view variables 'queues'/'callableQueues' and 'waitingTickets'/'tickets' (Serve.php:146-151); grantAccess/revokeAccess are near-duplicates (Queues.php:234-260).

readability.evidence: Clear names, short methods, docblocks marking untrusted state (Queues.php:31-55, Serve.php:27-39), view structure mirrors members page. Unused duplicate view keys and untyped $id parameters are small blemishes.

scope.evidence: All changes serve the task: two components, views, routes, navbar links, lang keys, members tabs and the necessary test adjustments. Extra lang keys (serve_rate_limited, queues_active, etc.) support the requested UI.

issues.explanation: Two new Livewire components ship without any tests (happy path, validation failure, unauthorized call, tamper/foreign-id), which the TDD convention and the Livewire definition of done require.
Page tests were relaxed: invite-label assertions dropped and assertDontSee('Invite member') in the pt_BR test is now vacuous since the invite form is not rendered on the default tab.
Client-writable input properties (mode, name, renameName, activeTab) lack #[Validate]/$this->validate(), contrary to the project's Livewire pattern.
CallMode::tryFrom(...) ?? CallMode::Any silently calls in 'any' mode for a tampered mode instead of CallMode::from as specified.
callableQueues() and selectedQueue() are public and thus callable endpoints; selectedQueue() returns any same-entity queue without a 'call' check — they should be private/protected.
New routes and pages are not reflected in CHANGELOG.md or docs as the docs-sync convention requires.
Duplicate view variables ('queues'/'callableQueues', 'waitingTickets'/'tickets'); only one of each is used.

review.summary: The change implements the queues management page, the serve panel, members tabs, navigation and translations largely as specified, with correct entity-scoped id resolution, server-side authorization through policies and domain actions, and a confirmation modal. However, it adds no tests at all for the two new Livewire components (no unauthorized-call or tamper tests), which the project's TDD and Livewire policy make mandatory, and it skips #[Validate] on input properties and docs/CHANGELOG updates, so it cannot be approved as is.
